//: Committed .claude/settings.json for a repo. These are EXAMPLE defaults — review the deny list against this repo's real layout before relying on it. Settings are hard-enforced by Claude Code (deny evaluated before ask before allow), unlike CLAUDE.md guidance. Personal, non-committed overrides go in .claude/settings.local.json (gitignored).

_notes.review: Add repo-specific sensitive paths (deploy manifests, infra state like *.tfstate, cloud config). Remove a deny only if the repo genuinely needs it — e.g. allow a specific curl via an allow rule rather than dropping the blanket deny.
_notes.build_artifacts: node_modules/, dist/, build/, __pycache__/, .venv/ belong in .gitignore, not here — this file controls tool access, not version control.
_notes.hooks: For rules that must run every time (e.g. block a commit that contains a secret), add a PreToolUse hook — stronger than deny for lifecycle enforcement.
